entities.name: Sandro Mariátegui
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sandro Mariátegui Chiappe was a Peruvian politician. He was Minister of Economy and Finance from 1965 to 1967. He served as the President of the Senate from July 1982 to July 1983. Mariátegui was the prime minister of Peru from 10 April until 12 October 1984. He was the son of José Carlos Mariátegui. He died on 28 September 2013, aged 91.
